visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a light blue Qing dynasty robe and a woman in a vibrant pink and blue traditional costume with a large flowered headpiece pose in front of a studded red door in a brightly lit indoor space. They strike a pose, then the woman playfully grabs the man, and they both stumble and fall out of the frame. (2) A group shot shows approximately fifteen to twenty people, all dressed in various colorful Qing dynasty costumes, posing and cheering in a banquet-style room. The scene cuts to the woman in pink standing behind a gold cart with a large white cake. (3) Two women in traditional dress sit at a table in a dining room with grey partitioned walls. They wave white handkerchiefs and laugh while looking at each other. A man in a white and red costume sits nearby. (4) A man in a white chef-like outfit is seen crushing yellow crispy crackers inside a plastic bag and then sprinkling the pieces onto the top of the white cake. The woman in pink holds a sparkler next to the cake. (5) A lotus-shaped candle on the cake is lit; it initially emits black smoke and a large flame before blooming into multiple smaller candles that spin while playing music. The woman reacts with wide eyes and a bright smile. (6) The woman stands behind the cake with her hands pressed together in prayer, delivering a speech to the surrounding guests. She alternates between a serious, emotional expression and laughing. (7) A close-up shows the plastic lotus candle spinning and playing music while held by a hand over a dining table.
